description: This file defines state management and provider setup for authentication in a Flutter app using Riverpod. It includes the AuthState class, which tracks authentication status, loading, errors, and user info, as well as the AuthController class, which manages actions like initialize, login, register, and logout. It also declares providers for the AuthRepository and the AuthController.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: Encapsulates the authentication state, including whether the user is authenticated, loading status, error message, and user data.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A state notifier that manages authentication actions such as initialize, login, register, and logout, updating the auth state accordingly.

methods.name: AuthState.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the AuthState with optional updated fields.

methods.name: AuthState.initial
methods.description: Factory constructor that initializes the AuthState with default values.

methods.name: AuthController.initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authentication state by checking for existing tokens.

methods.name: AuthController.login
methods.description: Performs login using the repository and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: AuthController.register
methods.description: Performs user registration and updates the state based on response.

methods.name: AuthController.logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and resets the authentication state.
